The user wants a restrained remaster of the original Viper helmet so it is still immediately recognizable, NOT a replacement design. Keep its existing muted steel-blue armor, broad curved crown, cyan-blue brow and jaw trim, charcoal ear/undersuit sections, and purple smoked visor island in the LOWER RIGHT. Improve painting quality: resolve blurry edges with clean precise small bevel highlights; slightly deepen existing assembly seams; subtle believable painted-metal variation; cleaner charcoal composite; delicate purple glass sheen. Preserve the original broad hand-painted light/dark volumes and all color region boundaries. Mostly clean broad panels with VERY restrained wear, no scattered noise, no gritty grain, no bolts that change layout, no new LEDs, no engraving patterns, no thick white outlines.
